fusions.name: Darning Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darning needles at once, each dealing 3 damage, with a 15% chance per hit to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flower to Flower
fusions.desc: Throws a bobbin that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on that enemy spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Hive of Needles
fusions.desc: Sets down a hive sewn from cloth for 12 seconds. It looses a needle at an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.2 seconds for 4 damage.

fusions.name: Stinging Seam
fusions.desc: Every hit you land sews a stitch into that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all pull at once: a blow strikes it for 34% of your weapon damage per stitch (170% at full). Unfed, a stitch fades every 4 seconds.
